title: Customization list page
description: A section page of the Customizations editor: the rounded content panel with the section title (Browse button; Plugins adds a ⋯ More Marketplace Actions button), the description with its Learn more link, a "Type to search..." input and the grouped tree of installed customizations (User, Workspace, Plugins, Remote, Built-in). `kind="prompts"` is the prompt-file list (Skills, Instructions, Agents, Hooks); `mcp` and `plugins` are the plugin list widget. Applies `narrow-layout` below 500px and `wide-layout` from 600px, like the product. The product virtualizes the tree (absolutely positioned rows in a fixed-height list); here rows flow and the list scrolls natively.
usage: Inside <vsc-customizations-editor> with `section` set. Product copy — Skills: "Folders of instructions, scripts, and resources that Copilot loads when relevant to perform specialized tasks." (Learn more about agent skills); Instructions: "Define common guidelines and rules that automatically influence how AI generates code and handles development tasks." (Learn more about custom instructions); Agents: "Configure the AI to adopt different personas tailored to specific development tasks. Each agent has its own instructions, tools, and behavior." (Learn more about custom agents); Hooks: "Prompts executed at specific points during an agentic lifecycle." (Learn more about hooks); MCP Servers: "An open standard that lets AI use external tools and services. MCP servers provide tools for file operations, databases, APIs, and more." (Learn more about MCP servers); Plugins: "Extend your AI agent with plugins that add commands, skills, agents, hooks, and MCP servers from reusable packages." (Learn more about agent plugins).
